components.cost_effect: One dense spectral floor/reconstruction and one exact Mahalanobis projection per state; no new loss/gradient sample.
components.goal: Keep history means feasible and covariance nonsingular without increasing KL from a smoothed feasible comparator.
components.key_estimate: For every u in W and Q_u=N(u,tau^2 I), KL(Q_u||N(mplus,Sigmaplus))<=KL(Q_u||N(a,C)); input covariance bounds are preserved.
components.name: Covariance floor and metric projection
components.operation: Replace tilted covariance eigenvalues below tau^2 by tau^2, then project the tilted mean in the inverse floored covariance metric.
components.requires: 0<tau<=D, input covariance invariant, and exact projection on closed convex W.
transfer_checks: Comparator covariance must be exactly tau^2 I for the displayed scalar flooring argument.
Approximate projections or covariance approximations require separate accumulated-error control.
End-to-end regret also needs the surrogate, sparse history schedule, grid and master.

content.family: Rank-one Gaussian exponential tilting with covariance flooring

limitations.statement: This record is a single-state component. It does not specify the full dyadic grid, streaming births/deaths or exponential-weights master and carries no standalone regret guarantee.
The arithmetic implementation uses exact projection; the separate polynomial-bit oracle model is not supplied by this interface.

content.local_correctness_argument: Collecting quadratic and linear terms after multiplying the Gaussian density by exp(-lambda tilde f) gives the displayed Aplus and bplus, hence tilted Gaussian N(a,C). Since Aplus>=A, C<=Sigma<=D^2 I; flooring only to tau^2<=D^2 preserves the covariance invariant. For KL flooring monotonicity, use an eigenbasis of C and write r_j=(U^T(u-a))_j. Up to unchanged constants, twice KL is sum_j[(tau^2+r_j^2)/c_j+log c_j]. For c_j<=tau^2 its derivative is (c_j-tau^2-r_j^2)/c_j^2<=0. Raising such eigenvalues to tau^2 cannot increase KL. For Aflat=Cflat^(-1), the projection variational inequality is (a-mplus)^T Aflat(u-mplus)<=0 for every u in W. Expanding norms gives ||u-mplus||_Aflat^2<=||u-a||_Aflat^2-||a-mplus||_Aflat^2. The covariance KL terms remain unchanged, so projection also cannot increase KL. This proves the component estimate, not an end-to-end regret bound.

variants.cost: One exact metric projection plus dense spectral computation and reconstruction: O(d^3+C_proj(d)) arithmetic operations and O(d^2) stored real numbers per state. Supplied gradient is reused. O(d^2) total spectral-update cost requires an additional primitive covering the complete update, floor and reconstruction; rank-one inversion alone is insufficient.
variants.implementation_details_ref: Appendix B.1.3, pp.15–17, equations (20)–(27); B.2 cost discussion p.23
variants.name: Exact real-arithmetic single-history update
variants.output: New Gaussian state N(mplus,Sigmaplus), with mplus in W and tau^2 I<=Sigmaplus<=D^2 I.
public_inputs: Known nonempty compact convex W of diameter at most D>0; G,eta>0; gamma=min{eta/2,1/(4GD)}, lambda=gamma/2
Floor radius 0<tau<=D; current Gaussian N(m,Sigma), m in W and tau^2 I<=Sigma<=D^2 I
Current shared master prediction w in W and supplied g=grad f(w), ||g||_2<=G
variants.query_and_update: Set A=Sigma^(-1), Aplus=A+lambda gamma gg^T, bplus=Am-lambda g+lambda gamma(g^T w)g, C=Aplus^(-1), a=C bplus. Equivalently this tilts N(m,Sigma) by exp(-lambda[<g,v-w>+(gamma/2)<g,v-w>^2]). For C=U diag(c_j)U^T form Cflat=U diag(max{c_j,tau^2})U^T. Query the exact projection oracle with a and metric Cflat^(-1), obtaining mplus in argmin_{v in W}(v-a)^T Cflat^(-1)(v-a). Store Sigmaplus=Cflat.
variants.requirements: Exact real arithmetic and an oracle returning argmin_{v in W}(v-a)^T A(v-a) for every a in R^d and positive-definite A, charged C_proj(d). The shared gradient is supplied by the enclosing learner; no extra gradient is queried by this state transform.
variants.state_and_initialization: At history birth choose fixed w_0 in W and initialize N(w_0,D^2 I). The input invariant is m in W and tau^2 I<=Sigma<=D^2 I.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: One invocation performs one update at fixed tau. It has no independent stopping rule, horizon adaptation, scale selection or comparator-path input.
